title: Maximizing Efficiencies in Universal Service Administration
pass_4_primary_concern: The sample-based audit recovery and expanded audit authority are under-specified while the notice also contemplates efficiency and reporting changes.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: The rule governs public universal-service funding, audits, recovery, and payment continuity for schools, libraries, providers, and rural health care entities.
pass_5_red_flag_gates: Harm Before Review Plus Structural Lever
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal has a plausible stewardship objective, but its most consequential audit and recovery mechanisms are not operationally specified.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: A participant could face a recovery or payment delay before it can reconstruct and contest the basis for the decision.
